summary: The space room's select-game command was accepted from anyone connected (the room route is open to anyone and no command gate existed), so a joined member or someone not in the space could make the game choice; only the host (spaces:select-game) may. Fixed: the room gateway decides the actor's space grants through the permission layer at upgrade, strips any client-supplied grants, and the room refuses SelectGame without them. Found by the space-roles decision table.
